summary: A coarser view of a finer triangle now adds up along the calendar diagonal instead of mixing valuation dates.
details: Opening a monthly or quarterly triangle at a coarser period built each annual cell from figures valued at up to twelve different dates, so every cell of the view was wrong.
A coarse cell whose parts are not all present is now blank rather than a partial sum, and a roll-up that cannot line up on one valuation date is refused with a plain reason.
